Site: 5 Alder Close, Eastmere
Dwelling: detached, 3 bedrooms
Proposal: two-storey side extension towards the side garden
The oak in the side garden will be 3.5 m from the new side wall.

In our view the oak is well clear of the works and no tree issues arise.
Foundations will be conventional strip footings.

T1 oak, mature, good condition, in the side garden of No. 5.
T1 is protected by Tree Preservation Order 14/2019.
Stem diameter not measured: access to the base of T1 was refused on the survey day.
Root protection area therefore not calculated.
